name: Thaumaturgy (The Green Path) — 3 Advanced — Awaken the Forest Giants

system.description: By touching a tree, spending a Willpower Trait, and concentrating, you awaken it to walk and fight on your behalf. You must spend a Blood Trait for every two turns you wish it active; when the time expires it takes root permanently and cannot be animated again that night. An animated tree has 10 Physical Traits plus twice your Occult rating in Traits, a Brawl rating equal to your own, immunity to bashing damage, and halved non-aggravated lethal damage.
system.duration: Two turns per Blood Trait spent
